lines.text: WoW added the Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle Twitch drop Oct 13 - Nov 3, the Hexed Witchwick ($25-$50) and Whoofle Bramblewing ($25) shop items, and the window now reaches WoW's 22nd Anniversary and Legion Timewalking on Nov 17

Pokemon GO's Halloween Part II is now official (Shiny Greavard debut, Mega Sableye to Super Max), and GO Wild Area: Global Nov 14-15 ($11.99 ticket) plus Minior Showers: Leonids Nov 14-19 enter the window
Aniimo's Prismana Carnival Oct 19-25 and Glamour Star rounds through Nov 12 are on the calendar; Pokopia's current build is confirmed as 2.0.0
Ended and dropped: World Space Week, Zorua Community Day, the Gnomeregan Run, the PAX Aus keynote and Pokopia's Chansey Plant code; the Abyssal Crown bundle is no longer the featured shop item

needs_you.action: Finish both Sandile Hatch Day Timed Researches, free and the $1.99 paid track, by 5pm local the same day, or their rewards are lost
Rank up GO Pass: Fall Marathon and claim the free Pikachu visor Timed Research before Oct 19 at 8pm local; unlocked pass rewards expire Oct 21 at 8pm
Watch for Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes emailing from Oct 20 and pass them on; guests can only redeem them for launch week Nov 4-11

Open the game inside a participating Best Buy, GameStop or Target to pick up the TCG 30th Celebration Timed Research by Oct 20 at 10pm local (claim by Nov 20); redeem a store-bought GO gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap
City Safari: Boston ticket holders who do not want the rescheduled global gameplay Oct 24-25 must request a refund through in-app support by Oct 20 at 11:59pm EST
Buy the $4.99 Max Battle Day ticket before sales close Oct 24 at 5pm local, then watch 30 minutes of the Pokemon Twitch stream from 7:30pm PDT for the Night Out jersey code
Early Name Reservation opens Oct 27 (through Nov 3) for upgrade buyers; two-part names are first come, first served

Spend Windborn Stamps and claim Season Achievement rewards before Part I ends Oct 28 at 7:59pm on the Americas server (11:59pm UTC), when leftovers convert to Credits; Journey Chronicles login gifts close Oct 29 at 3:59am server time
Finish the October Traveler's Log for the Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Trader's Tender before the Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1
Trade pumpkin candy for Pumpkaboo's event furniture at the Pokemon Center before Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises ends Nov 1 at 4:59am local
Watch 4 hours of any World of Warcraft Twitch stream with a linked Battle.net account before Nov 3 at 10am PST to claim the Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle housing decor
Rank up GO Pass: October before rank earning stops Nov 3 at 10am local, using the uncapped GO Points Oct 31 - Nov 1; rewards expire Nov 5, and the Deluxe Lucky Trinket must be used by Nov 8
Rank up GO Pass: Halloween 2026 before it ends Nov 5 at 8pm local; unlocked rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm
Buy the $11.99 GO Wild Area: Global ticket on the Web Store before Nov 14 if you want the Gigantamax Duraludon Special Research, Shiny boost and 6 Special Trades a day across both event days

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts holiday and patch dates about 1-2 weeks ahead; Wowhead's calendar runs further out

timeline.title: Midnight 12.1.5: The Promise of Tomorrow
timeline.detail: The Unbinding of Kith'ix single-boss raid, the nine-chamber Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, Aqir Invasions in Eversong and Zul'Aman, Keystone Myth and a new campaign go live with Oct 13 maintenance; the crest cap lifts and Ascendant Venomstones unlock the week of Oct 20.

timeline.title: Midnight Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss
timeline.detail: Season 2 continues with the Venomous Abyss raid and a mid-season Mythic+ refresh; Blizzard has not announced a Season 2 end date.

timeline.title: Twitch Drop: Cuddly Gold-Colored Grrgle decor
timeline.detail: Watch 4 hours of any WoW stream on Twitch between Oct 13 at 10:00 a.m. PDT and Nov 3 at 10:00 a.m. PST with linked accounts, then buy extra copies from Dennia Silvertongue in Silvermoon.

timeline.title: Trading Post: Costumed Calamity in October
timeline.detail: Fill the Traveler's Log for Ensemble: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire and spend or freeze Tender before the stock changes over on Nov 1; November's lineup is not posted yet.

timeline.title: Hallow's End
timeline.detail: Fight the Headless Horseman daily for his mount and farm Tricky Treats for the holiday vendors; Blizzard has not posted this year's dates or new rewards yet.
timeline.estimate_basis: Wowhead's in-game calendar lists Oct 19 - Nov 2; no Blizzard post yet

timeline.title: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking
timeline.detail: Queue Draenor Timewalking for the weekly cache and the Garrison-era vendor transmog.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire (November)
timeline.detail: Ride the carousel for the XP buff and turn in profession quests during the Faire's November week.

timeline.title: Day of the Dead
timeline.detail: Visit a graveyard outside a capital city to dance with Catrina for the Macabre Marionette pet and holiday cooking.

timeline.title: Midnight Dungeon Event
timeline.detail: The final boss of every Midnight dungeon drops an extra item; complete four Mythic runs for the weekly bonus-event cache.

timeline.title: Moonkin Festival (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Spend a day as a moonkin in Moonglade for the micro-holiday's toys and achievements.

timeline.title: WoW's 22nd Anniversary
timeline.detail: The anniversary celebration opens on the window's last day and runs to Dec 8; Blizzard has not posted this year's rewards yet.

timeline.title: Legion Timewalking
timeline.detail: Legion Timewalking returns with the Mage Tower challenge and its dungeon week starting Nov 17.

timeline.title: Hexed Witchwick Collection
timeline.detail: Four broom-mount and transmog packs (Blushing, Autumnal, Wintry, Moonlit) sell for $25 each or $50 for all four, with the price adjusting for pieces you already own.

timeline.title: Whoofle Bramblewing owl mount
timeline.detail: The new $25 owl mount is shared across all modern WoW characters and works as a ground mount until flying unlocks.

weekly_rhythm: Week of Oct 13 (now): 12.1.5 goes live with maintenance; Battleground and Pet Battle Bonus Events; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse; Orin offers "Ancient Depths, Ancient Venom" after maintenance
Week of Oct 20: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk; the crest cap lifts and Orin's "Ascending with Venomstones" unlocks Ascendant Venomstones; Hallow's End runs from Oct 19
Week of Oct 27: Warlords of Draenor Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Trading Post rotates to November on Nov 1; Darkmoon Faire from Oct 31; Day of the Dead Nov 1-3; Hallow's End ends Nov 2
Week of Nov 3: Midnight Dungeon Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble; Twitch drop ends Nov 3; Darkmoon Faire through Nov 7; WoW: Forever launches Nov 4
Week of Nov 10: Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Moonkin Festival Nov 12-13
Nov 17 (window end): WoW's 22nd Anniversary, Legion Timewalking and PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu all begin at reset
just_past_window: Nov 24 - Dec 1: World Quest Bonus Event and PvP Brawl: Southshore vs. Tarren Mill
Dec 8: WoW's 22nd Anniversary ends; Battle for Azeroth Timewalking and PvP Brawl: Packed House begin

games.typical_lead_time: Blizzard posts Forever dates on the WoW news site, usually 1-2 weeks ahead

timeline.title: WoW: Forever beta
timeline.detail: Oct 21 is the last full day of testing for Epic Pack and Collection buyers and opt-in invitees; the open Server Slam Blizzard promised still has no date as of Oct 13.

timeline.title: Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes start emailing
timeline.detail: Codes email to Heroic (one) and Epic or Collection (three) buyers from Oct 20; forward them so friends can play launch week Nov 4-11 without a subscription.

timeline.title: Escape Together: Scarlet Monastery showdown stream
timeline.detail: Watch Horde and Alliance teams race through head-to-head challenges and a Scarlet Monastery escape room on the Warcraft Twitch and YouTube channels; Blizzard has not announced the stream time.

timeline.title: Early Name Reservation
timeline.detail: Any upgrade buyer can create and customize up to three characters and lock two-part names, first come first served, before launch.

timeline.title: WoW: Forever launches
timeline.detail: Forever opens globally at 3:00 p.m. PST with 4 new zones, 9 new dungeons, the Skyborne race and the 15v15 Darkspear Islands battleground, included with any WoW subscription or Game Time; Epic Pack and Collection buyers get 30 days of Game Time added that day.

timeline.title: Pre-purchase upgrades: Heroic $29.99, Epic $59.99, Collection $79.99
timeline.detail: The Skyborne Heroic Pack unlocks the Skyborne race and name reservation, the Epic Pack adds beta access and 30 days of Game Time, and the Warcraft Forever Collection adds Warcraft III: Reforged with Forsaken Kingdom and is sold only through Jan 11, 2027.

timeline.title: Collector's Edition restock
timeline.detail: The restocked physical Collector's Edition (statue, mousepad, pins, journal and the Collection digital code) is limited to one per household and ships February 2027, after launch.

weekly_rhythm: Beta cadence: realm restarts, Known Issues and Development Notes posts land most weekdays on the Forever forums (see the Wowhead Blue Tracker); the latest build gives every character 16 Legacy Points to test
Rulesets at launch are Normal, PvP and Roleplaying; Hardcore joins in winter 2026 per Wowhead's roadmap
Per Wowhead's roadmap: the first three raids (Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, Onyxia's Lair) open Dec 9
Invite-A-Friend guests lose access after Nov 11 and need a subscription or Game Time from then on

games.typical_lead_time: Niantic posts event details 1-3 weeks ahead; the month's schedule drops near the end of the prior month

timeline.title: Season 24: Twilight Trails
timeline.detail: Seasonal spawns, Paldean debuts, Mega Staraptor and Chandelure, and GO Battle League Mega Editions run through Dec 1 at 10am local.

timeline.title: Fall Marathon: Buddy Trek
timeline.detail: Bramblin debuts from Incense and GO Pass tasks, Mega Manectric can reach Super Max level, and the event GO Pass Deluxe is $4.99 ($6.99 with 6 ranks); rewards expire Oct 21 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: GO Pass: October
timeline.detail: Free track pays out a Kyogre encounter; Deluxe ($7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks) adds a Lucky Trinket and Super Incubator; GO Points are uncapped Oct 31 - Nov 1, rewards expire Nov 5 at 10am local.

timeline.title: Pokemon TCG 30th Celebration
timeline.detail: Open the game inside a Best Buy, GameStop or Target to grab the Timed Research (claim by Nov 20) and fight Mega Gengar in store raids; redeem a store-bought gift card by Oct 31 for the Gengar Knit Cap.

timeline.title: adidas | Pokemon Timed Research
timeline.detail: Pick up the free Timed Research at a participating adidas store by Jan 15 for the jacket and cap, and redeem code ADIDASxPOKEMON on the Web Store for the shoes.

timeline.title: Sandile Hatch Day
timeline.detail: Sandile hatches from 2 km Eggs at half distance with 2x hatch Candy; the free Timed Research and the $1.99 track (1/4 hatch distance, two Super Incubators) both expire at 5pm local.

timeline.title: Minior Showers: Orionids
timeline.detail: Minior debuts in the wild from Oct 19 at 5pm through Oct 24 at 11:59pm local, with shooting-star skies and boosted spawns 5-9pm nightly.

timeline.title: Dynamax Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Dynamax Azelf debuts in the Americas with 8x Max Particles from Power Spots; the $4.99 ticket (Max Mushroom, 6,400 MP) is only sold until 5pm local, and the remote raid cap doubles Oct 23-24.

timeline.title: City Safari: Boston (rescheduled, ticket holders only)
timeline.detail: The washed-out Boston event now runs as global gameplay for current ticket holders, with Timed Research for Flabebe, Hawlucha, Mudbray and Komala; refunds must be requested by Oct 20 at 11:59pm EST.

timeline.title: Pokemon Night Out Twitch drop
timeline.detail: Watch 30 minutes of the Pokemon Twitch stream with a linked Trainer Central account for a Timed Research code that unlocks the Night Out baseball jersey.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part I
timeline.detail: Costumed Pikachu, Zubat and Sinistea debut with trick-or-treat surprises; the Halloween GO Pass runs through Nov 5 (Deluxe $7.99, or $9.99 with 10 ranks) and its rewards expire Nov 7 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Super Mega Raid Day (October)
timeline.detail: A three-hour Super Mega Raid Day is on the calendar for Halloween afternoon; the featured Mega has not been announced.

timeline.title: Halloween 2026 Part II
timeline.detail: Shiny Greavard debuts in the wild and research, Mega Sableye can reach Super Max level with the Night Shade+ Charged Attack, and the shared Halloween GO Pass closes Nov 5 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026: Global
timeline.detail: Gigantamax Duraludon, Dynamax Dialga (Nov 14) and Dynamax Palkia (Nov 15) debut with Steel and Dragon habitat hours and GO Safari Balls for everyone; the optional $11.99 ticket adds Special Research, a Shiny boost and 6 Special Trades a day.

timeline.title: Minior Showers: Leonids
timeline.detail: A second Minior core color debuts from Nov 14 at 5pm through Nov 19 at 11:59pm local, with boosted spawns 5-9pm nightly.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6-7pm local
Spotlight Hours: Stufful Oct 15 (2x transfer Candy); Morelull Oct 22 (2x catch Stardust); Gastly Oct 29 (2x evolve XP); November not yet posted
Max Mondays: Sneasel Oct 19; Sableye Oct 26; November not yet posted

5-star raids: Dialga Oct 14-20; Palkia Oct 21-27; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28 - Nov 3; Nov 4-13 not yet announced; Wild Area Global brings Zekrom and White Kyurem Nov 14, Reshiram and Black Kyurem Nov 15
Raid Hours: Dialga Oct 14; Palkia Oct 21; Giratina (Origin) Oct 28
Mega Raids: Dragonite Oct 14-20; Charizard X and Y Oct 21-27; Sableye Oct 28 - Nov 3; Shadow Landorus in weekend Shadow Raids through Nov 3

GO Battle League (rotates Tuesdays 1pm PDT): Great, Ultra Mega and Little Cup Oct 13-20; Ultra, Master Mega and Fantasy Cup Oct 20-27; Master and Mega Halloween Cup Oct 27 - Nov 3; Mega Editions of all three leagues Nov 3-10; Great, Ultra Mega and 2026 GO LAIC Cup Nov 10-17; Ultra, Master Mega and LAIC Cup Nov 17-24

In-person and regional: Wild Area 2026 in Sendai and Mexico City Nov 6-8 (ticketed, on site, no US stop); Festival of Lights Nov 6-8 is India only; Daily Discoveries pause Nov 9-15 ahead of Wild Area Global per Leek Duck
just_past_window: Nov 21: November Community Day, 2-5pm local (featured Pokemon not announced)
Nov 24 - Dec 1: GO Battle League Master League and Mega Catch Cup close out the season
Nov 28: Super Mega Raid Day, 2-5pm local; Twilight Trails ends Dec 1 at 10am local

games.typical_lead_time: The Pokemon Company announces Pokopia events about 2-3 weeks ahead on pokemon.com

timeline.title: Pumpkaboo's Sweet Surprises
timeline.detail: Learn Camouflage from Zorua, prank Pokemon for pumpkin candy and trade it at the Pokemon Center for spooky furniture before Nov 1 at 4:59am local; Pumpkaboo and Gourgeist stay afterward.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the launch Ditto Rug via Mystery Gift over the internet before Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass: Part 1 out now, Part 2 late 2026
timeline.detail: The pass includes Bubbly Basin now, accessories and new Pokemon in Part 2 late this year (no new town), and a third town in 2027; buying by Aug 31, 2027 emails a code for 30 rare Pokemetal ingots, valid through Sep 30, 2027.

weekly_rhythm: Version 2.0.0 (Aug 5) is still the current build: Dive, Bubbly Basin, the portal pod and bulk storage moves; no newer patch has shipped
No Mystery Gift codes are active for US players; the Berry Furniture Set code from Oct 29 is for Japan and Korea retail bundles only
just_past_window: Expansion Pass Part 2 is still only dated "late 2026": accessories, new furniture and Pokemon, no new town

games.typical_lead_time: Pawprint posts update notices on aniimo.com about 2 days before maintenance

timeline.title: Windchaser's Departure: Irisalis
timeline.detail: Collect weekly Iris Petals to craft the Legendary Aniipod for Irisalis, then the Blessing Gifts pod for a guaranteed Perfect-potential Sparkling capture, before Dec 9 at 7:59pm on the Americas server.

timeline.title: Journey Chronicles login event
timeline.detail: Log in on enough days to claim every travel gift, including the day-7 Sparkling Egg, before the event closes Oct 29 at 3:59am server time.

timeline.title: Vein Abundance: Prismana Carnival
timeline.detail: Prismana Glynsera, Melloblum, Waleetle and Inferlupa all spawn at once in their regions to close out Part I.
timeline.estimate_basis: Official Korean launch poster and in-game calendar via AniimoTools; no English notice yet

timeline.title: Season 1 Part II and a new region
timeline.detail: The in-game Season Overview promises a brand-new region with Part II after Oct 29 maintenance; unspent Windborn Stamps convert to Credits when Part I ends Oct 28, and Windchaser Stamps start from zero.
timeline.estimate_basis: In-game Season Overview as reported by AniimoTools; no official notice yet

timeline.title: Carry over your beta rewards
timeline.detail: Log in with the email you used for the beta tests, or link it in Account Center before creating a character, or the test rewards cannot be claimed.

weekly_rhythm: Holo-Battle Interlink runs weekly from Thursday 04:00 to Monday 03:59 server time, with Star Rank and Support rewards resetting each cycle; Hatch Haste halves egg timers every Friday to Sunday

Shop features the Frostburst Punk set (680 Lumin Crystals) and the Forest of Butterfly Dreams appearance since the Sep 30 patch; the Radiant Waveglow set (980) and Laurel Moon Blessing pack (280) remain
Per the in-game calendar (unofficial): Vein Abundance in Nimbus Fields Oct 12-18 (Prismana Inferlupa), Glamour Star Oct 9-15, Oct 23-29 and Nov 6-12, Who's That Aniimo? Oct 16-22 and Oct 30 - Nov 5

Dev Feedback (Oct 12): Operation: Egg Heist gets small updates every two weeks, the second half of Season 1 adds casual competitive modes and new Collectible sources, and version 1.1 (no date) fixes Irisalis's Innate Potential
just_past_window: Nov 20-26: Glamour Star round five, per the in-game calendar
